data.title: Peter Schiff Doubles Down On His ‘Black Monday’ Call Again: Ethereum Could Hit $1,000 In Two Days
data.description: Peter Schiff warned late Friday that Ethereum (ETH) could plunge to $1,000 by Monday after the token fell below the key support level of $1600.Schiff said that there is a real risk of a crypto crash over the weekend that could send Ethereum to $1,000 by Monday.
